title: Cast Upon the Breakers
author: Alger, Horatio, Jr.
description: "Cast Upon the Breakers" by Horatio Alger, Jr.
longDescription: is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around the life of Rodney Ropes, a young boy who faces adversity after the loss of his family fortune due to the malfeasance of his guardian.

authorInfo.bio: Alger, Horatio, Jr. (1832–1899) is the author of Cast Upon the Breakers. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
